title: Battery deep-discharge protection
body: CubeSat battery state-of-charge below 30 % shall trigger autonomous load-shed of all payload subsystems. Only ADCS, comms beacon, and EPS housekeeping continue. Recovery to nominal occurs after charge ≥ 60 %.
citation: NanoRacks CubeSat Deployer Interface Document NCDID-2018

title: Beacon-only safe mode after N missed contacts
body: If a CubeSat misses N consecutive scheduled ground contacts (typical N=8), it shall enter beacon-only safe mode: ADCS off, payload off, beacon transmitter on for 60 s every 30 min. Recovery requires ground command or T+72 h watchdog reset.
citation: Libre Space Foundation SatNOGS recovery best-practices

title: Detumbling after deployment
body: CubeSat shall execute B-dot detumbling for 90 minutes after deployment from launch vehicle. Body rates must converge to < 1 deg/s before any sun-pointing or comms attitude commanded.

title: Post-mission deorbit compliance
body: Per FCC and ITU rules, CubeSats in LEO shall passively deorbit within 5 years of mission end. Operators must demonstrate compliance via orbital decay calculation or active deorbit device (drag sail, brake).

title: Watchdog timer reset recovery
body: If on-board computer hangs > 30 minutes, hardware watchdog forces a power-cycle. After reset, EPS verifies battery state and re-runs deployment-config script. Deployment is idempotent (re-running is safe).
